title: The Stupid Monkeys
author: Ellen C. Babbitt
summary: 猴子替园丁浇树，却把树苗拔起来看根，结果树全死了。
publicDomainBasis: Retold by Ellen C. Babbitt and published in 1922 by The Century Co. (pre-1923, public domain in the United States); Project Gutenberg releases it as public domain.

paragraphs.en: Once upon a time a king gave a holiday to all the people in one of his cities.
paragraphs.zh: 从前，有一位国王给他城里所有的百姓放了一天假。

paragraphs.en: The king's gardener thought to himself: "All my friends are having a holiday in the city. I could go into the city and enjoy myself with them if I did not have to water the trees here in this garden. I know what I will do. I will get the Monkeys to water the young trees for me." In those days, a tribe of Monkeys lived in the king's garden.
paragraphs.zh: 国王的园丁心想：“我的朋友们都在城里过节。要不是得给这园子里的树浇水，我也能进城跟他们一起快活。我知道怎么办。我让猴子们替我浇这些小树。”那时候，国王的园子里住着一群猴子。

paragraphs.en: So the gardener went to the Chief of the Monkeys, and said: "You are lucky Monkeys to be living in the king's garden. You have a fine place to play in. You have the best of food--nuts, fruit, and the young shoots of trees to eat. You have no work at all to do. You can play all day, every day. To-day my friends are having a holiday in the city, and I want to enjoy myself with them. Will you water the young trees so that I can go away?"
paragraphs.zh: 于是园丁去找猴王，说：“你们这些猴子真走运，住在国王的园子里。你们有玩耍的好地方，有最好的食物——坚果、水果和嫩树枝可吃。你们什么活儿也不用干，每天都能玩上一整天。今天我的朋友们在城里过节，我想去跟他们一起快活。你们肯替我浇浇小树，让我走开吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, yes!" said the Chief of the Monkeys. "We shall be glad to do that."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，愿意！”猴王说，“我们很乐意干。”

paragraphs.en: "Do not forget to water the trees when the sun goes down. See they have plenty of water, but not too much," said the gardener. Then he showed them where the watering-pots were kept, and went away.
paragraphs.zh: “太阳下山后别忘了浇树。要让它们喝足水，可也别太多。”园丁说完，指给他们看水壶放在哪儿，就走了。

paragraphs.en: When the sun went down the Monkeys took the watering-pots, and began to water the young trees. "See that each tree has enough water," said the Chief of the Monkeys.
paragraphs.zh: 太阳下山后，猴子们拿起水壶，开始浇小树。“每一棵树都要浇够水。”猴王说。

paragraphs.en: "How shall we know when each tree has enough?" they asked. The Chief of the Monkeys had no good answer, so he said: "Pull up each young tree and look at the length of its roots. Give a great deal of water to those with long roots, but only a little to those trees that have short roots."
paragraphs.zh: “我们怎么知道哪棵树浇够了呢？”它们问。猴王没有好答案，就说：“把每棵小树拔起来，看看根有多长。根长的多浇水，根短的就少浇点。”

paragraphs.en: Then those stupid Monkeys pulled up all the young trees to see which trees had long roots and which had short roots.
paragraphs.zh: 于是那些蠢猴子把小树全都拔起来，看哪些树根长、哪些树根短。

paragraphs.en: When the gardener came back the next day, the poor young trees were all dead.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天园丁回来时，可怜的小树全都死了。
